decision: Retain all 11 informative targets as uncertain and all other targets as unmentioned. No automatic report selection, label duplication or virtual study splitting. Raw source and gold unchanged.
findings: The second complete report explicitly identifies right knee; the first lacks an overall side heading but contains m.semimembranosus dex., a right-sided muscle reference. Thus the text does not establish two opposite knees despite the literal bilateral marker. Same-knee longitudinal documentation or mispaired text is plausible; no explicit comparison date/chronology selects which block is current. The full source and both blocks match the archived/current official field exactly. Twelve endpoints cover all six series. All Laterality values are R; other side fields blank. One PatientID hash and six frame hashes. SeriesNumbers201/301/401/501/601/701 and AcquisitionNumbers2 through7 describe three sagittal contrasts, two coronal contrasts and one axial contrast, with compatible IOP. T2 sagittal has15 slices while other series have29–32, an ordinary protocol-coverage difference by metadata alone. There is no repeated complete acquisition set or mixed side-tag group strongly suggesting both knees.
